leaves.name: mainTheoremCM
leaves.doc: qmrec-printed: the main theorem of complex multiplication, adelic form with torsion (printed form): for a CM field E with CM type Phi, its reflex field E* (generated by the type traces) and reflex norm N (det_E on a model of C^Phi over E*), sigma in Aut(C) and an idele s of E* with sigma = [s, E*] on E*^ab (Tau Ceti's Artin map), an abelian variety A/C uniformized by C^g/Phi(a) of type (E, Phi): A^sigma is uniformized by C^g/Phi(t^-1 a), t = N(s)^eps, with theta(Phi(x))^sigma = theta'(Phi(y)) whenever t y - x lies in a-hat. Sign eps existential (Shimura's normalization: eps = 1). Proves QMReciprocityL3 (qmReciprocityL3_of_textbook) and with shimura-split2's glue the field rayClassCMAb.
leaves.source: Shimura, Introduction to the arithmetic theory of automorphic functions (1971) section 5.5; Shimura, Abelian varieties with complex multiplication and modular functions (1998) section 18, Thm 18.6; Shimura-Taniyama (1961) sections 13-14; Milne, Introduction to Shimura varieties (2005) Thm 11.2; Milne, Complex multiplication (notes) section 9 (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: pelHolFamilyHodge
leaves.doc: pel-hodge: holfam's PELHolFamily with the fibre clause in the print's Hodge / H_1 form. Deligne's PEL moduli curve M_K3 over Q: a curve S proper and smooth of relative dimension 1 over Q, a QM abelian scheme with level-3 structure over S (QMAbScheme) whose field fibres are objects (QML3), and a holomorphic tau -> s_tau = [h_tau, 1] in S(C) (ShimuraSplit.IsHolFamily) whose fibre P has H_1(P.A(C), Z) = pi_1(P.A(C), 0)^ab (classical topology of unif-printed), with its O-action and Hodge structure, equal to (iota(O)(tau,1)^T, iota, i), i.e. to (O, left multiplication, h_tau) (IsHodgeFibre: a holomorphic homomorphism e : C^2 -> P.A(C), iota-compatible, killing Lambda_tau, with v -> [t -> e(t v)] a bijection Lambda_tau -> H_1). Implies holfam's lattice form with UniformizationLeafAll (pelHolFamily_of_hodge, proved) and conversely (pelHolFamilyHodge_of_pel, proved).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf; the fibre clause is now in the print's H_1 / Hodge form (dictionary H_1 = pi_1^ab, Lie A via holomorphic homomorphisms, ker exp = pi_1); the analytic clause (M_K(C) = G(Q)\X x G(A_f)/K as complex spaces, i.e. tau -> [h_tau,1] holomorphic) is to be checked in the same reading (holfam's flag)
leaves.source: Deligne, Travaux de Shimura, Sem. Bourbaki 389 (1971) sections 4.9-4.17 and Example 5.8 (M_K(C) = G(Q)\X x G(A_f)/K, the point [h,g] carrying the abelian variety with H_1(A,Q) = V, Hodge structure h, lattice gL); Milne, Introduction to Shimura varieties (2005) sections 8 and 14 (locators UNVERIFIED)
